neighbours.label: The lexical forms pose, poses, posed and posing across senses.
fire: Loose wires pose a hazard to the maintenance crew.
The storm poses a serious risk to small boats.
The delay posed a problem for the event organizers.
The guests were posing for a photograph beside the fountain.
The journalist will pose a question about the budget.
The artist asked the model to pose beside the window.
She posed as a customer to inspect the service.
The dancer held the pose until the music stopped.
quiet: Loose wires present a hazard to the maintenance crew.
The storm presents a serious risk to small boats.
The delay created a problem for the event organizers.
The guests were standing for a photograph beside the fountain.
The journalist will ask a question about the budget.
The artist asked the model to stand beside the window.
She acted as a customer to inspect the service.
The dancer held the position until the music stopped.

predictions: Fire sentences should outrank the matched near misses; assessed once by quick-8+8@2. Failure is retained without revision.
notes: Random 16-pole sweep. Labels derived from both-pole cards and top-32 peak-token counts. No band archive covers this neuron. Sentences authored by Codex; no Bonsai-generated sentences. Exploratory probes, when declared, used different sentences from this pre-registration.
